title: Tiny wins log + manager primers - Samira
content:
Purpose: capture small, verifiable wins and 30–90d manager primers. Quick, informal — meant for rehearsal and scanning before 1:1s.

Snapshot (today):
- Quick wins (last 6 weeks):
  - Reduced onboarding checklist time by ~18% by removing redundant KMS step (pilot feedback from 4 teams). Evidence: onboarding survey + time logs.
  - Ran two calibration syncs with Growth & SRE; created one cross-team FAQ doc that cut follow-up questions by ~40% in first week.
  - Coached Aisha on escalation template; got +1 CSAT on next customer call (anecdotal but noted).

- Small qualitative signals:
  - A PM pinged to say our “first-responder” checklist is the clearest internal doc they’ve seen — got used in 3 postmortems.
  - A new hire said they felt supported on day 3; logged in onboarding pulse.

Concrete metrics to pull before manager sync (data sources):
- Onboarding time median (source: spreadsheets/confluence table)
- Support ticket re-open rate for onboarding tickets (Zendesk/JIRA filter)
- # of cross-team docs created + views (Confluence analytics)

Manager primers (elevator lines / 90s scripts):
- Progress: "In the last 6 weeks I trimmed onboarding friction and ran cross-team calibrations; early signals show improved ramp time and fewer follow-ups. Next step is to automate the KMS check in the checklist and measure again."
- Ask (small/medium): "I’d like 2 days to prototype the automated KMS step with infra; if that reduces manual checks we can save ~30 engineering-hours/month. Can I book a small dev allocation?"
- Escalation cue: "If infra capacity is not available, propose a canary automation: a Lighthouse check that flags missing KMS entries and sends the onboarder a nudge."

Evidence snippets (copyable into Slack / 1:1):
- "Onboarding median dropped from 6.1 -> 5.0 days in pilot cohort (n=18) — still early but directionally promising. Full metric export linked."
- "Post-calibration follow-ups dropped by ~40% in week 1 (3→2 follow-ups per doc request) — users reported higher clarity."

Risks / open questions:
- Is the KMS automation introducing security edge cases? Need SRE/security review + quick threat model.
- Will removing step X create knowledge gaps for vendors? Add a short vendor-facing note.
- Data quality: onboarding time metric currently mixes voluntary and mandatory steps — need to standardize definitions.

Development experiments (things to try, quick scope):
1) A/B checklist wording (two-week pilot with two cohorts) — metric: follow-up rate after onboarding
2) Quick UX walkthrough video (2–3 minutes) added to checklist — metric: decrease in support asks within 72 hours
3) Templated postmortem FAQ snippet included in calibrations — metric: # times reused in 30d

Manager prep bullets (for tomorrow's 1:1):
- Lead with 2 wins, 1 ask (time or resource), 1 low-effort risk mitigation.
- Bring the metric snapshot (onboarding median + follow-ups) and one anecdote from a PM/new hire.
- Ask for permission to run the KMS automation prototype (timeline: 2 weeks + measurement).
- Optional: propose a small recognition note for the SRE engineer who quick-fixed the checklist bug.

Boilerplate answers to likely manager questions:
- Q: "How confident are you in the onboarding metric?"
  A: "Moderate. Pilot cohort is small and noisy; signal is consistent across two teams though. Planning to standardize step definitions before a broader rollout."

- Q: "If we don’t get dev time, what’s plan B?"
  A: "Run the checklist wording A/B test and add a UX video — both low-effort and likely to recover some of the gains."

Quick to-dos (next 7 days):
- Pull onboarding median spreadsheet + add note about definition (me) — due Thu.
- Draft request for 2-day dev allocation and attach cost/benefit summary (me).
- Ping security/SRE for 30-min threat check on automation idea (Marcus).
- Prepare one-sentence recognition note for SRE contributor (Aisha).

Notes-to-self / friction snippets: 
- Keep evidence copyable — manager prefers short, crisp sentences + one link.
- Don’t over-quantify before we standardize definitions. Use ranges and qualifiers.
- Capture 1 anecdote per win; managers remember stories.

Archive/links (placeholders):
- onboarding-metrics-sheet: CONFLUENCE-5472 (pull latest before 1:1)
- pilot-feedback-doc: CONFLUENCE-5510
- support-ticket-filter: JIRA-OPS-3321

End state next 90d:
- Onboarding median reduced by 15–25% across two cohorts, reproducible checklist + one small automation rolled to pilot, and a light playbook for cross-team calibration that is reused by two other teams.

Random brainstorms (dump):
- "Onboarding lightning demo" — 60s screencast embedded in the welcome email.
- "First 72-hour nudge" automated Slack note from buddy with checklist highlights.

This doc is intentionally rough. Keep short actionable lines; update before 1:1s and after any metric pulls.

Revision log: 
- 2025-11-03: Created initial tiny-wins ledger.
- 2026-01-18: Added metrics snapshot plan and manager scripts.
- 2026-02-12: Added ask draft + linked artifacts for prototype proposal.
